title: Recovery of the configuration core
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, and let $s$ be a natural number. Suppose configurations $C$ and $D$ have every work-tape head within distance $s$ of the origin, and every work-tape cell outside that interval is blank. If their configuration words are equal, then their cores together with their output summaries are equal.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
Both configurations' work-tape head positions have absolute value at most $s$
Both configurations have blank work-tape cells at positions whose absolute value exceeds $s$
Equality of the two configuration words
